question: Unifying Exp130 (808 nm 1.0 ms 41.15 J/cm^2 flash annealing) and Exp131 (M4 8.0+-1.0 nm 28Si epi cap, 24.15% -> 95.20% yield) into a single coupled BCA ion-implantation + flash TED + low-T 28Si MBE segregation/roughening + McWhorter/TLS Si/SiO2 interface charge-noise model: (1) how do Route A (post-anneal low-T MBE cap), Route B (through-cap 20-24 keV implant + flash), and Route C (Route A + 350 C forming-gas/atomic-H passivation) compare quantitatively across both the 5 keV M4 flip-flop target and the 14 keV (z0=15 nm) deep-donor regime; (2) to what physical S_eps does Route C suppress 1/f charge noise as a bridge to Exp137; and (3) what is the complete S5.6 CF100 In-Situ 28Si UHV MBE Capper hardware specification for CAD v5.0 and BOM v5.0?

method.charge_noise_and_m4_yield: Exact 2D image-charge McWhorter electrostatic integral for both Tosi donor-interface flip-flop detuning noise S_eps(z_d, z_int, d_ox, D_it) and buried-donor electric-field noise S_E(z_d, D_it) across Routes A/B/C, coupled directly into Exp131's exact 4x4 flip-flop Hamiltonian yield evaluator (N=2,000 donors/route).
method.s56_hardware_spec: Geometric CAD v4.0 load-lock integration check (CF100 top port on s5_loadlock_chamber at X=420, Y=0, Z=585 mm), 28Si sublimation/e-beam MBE capper mass/pressure/rate/cost/cryo-leak budget, and wafer throughput impact anchored to Exp134.
